backend/clues.mo: Defines CluesState with CRUD operations for text clues stored in a Map with auto-incrementing IDs.
backend/main.mo: Actor implementing user profiles and admin‑gated clue management using access control and Internet Identity.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing required frontend renaming to Echofields and listing affected files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files, describing routing, pages, components, hooks, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining OKLCH color tokens and dark mode styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting document title to Echofields and loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router routes under /echofields with layout, redirects, and theme provider.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with copyright text and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with a branded button navigating to /echofields.
Parses clue text for Markdown image syntax and safely renders text and images.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, reinitializing on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context, login/logout handling, and stored identity restoration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for listing, retrieving, creating, and deleting clues through the actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles, theme variables, Tailwind layers, and intro animation for the Echofields UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with Internet Identity and React Query providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin interface for authenticated owners to view, create, and delete clues with identity checks and UI states.
frontend/src/pages/CluePage.tsx: Displays a single clue by ID with loading, error handling, and navigation back to home.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page showing intro animation, project explanation, and entry point to the first clue if available.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Describes project metadata, known features, and pending rename request for Echofields.
